quotes.text: Bug 1894193 came from downstream TypeScript definition generation. An optional callback parameter must be marked optional even though the schema validator had ignored missing markers. On a callback result or object property, optional: true means the value may be undefined or omitted; a returned null needs an explicit null choice. The patch changes account and message-list result schemas and many callback declarations. For example, messages.MessageList.id is string or null, while cloudFile.getAccount may return undefined. Read actual returned values before changing a schema; do not use optional as a substitute for a null union.
